sides.snippet: Even so, let your light shine before men; that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father who is in heaven.
sides.verseText: Even so, let your light shine before men; that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father who is in heaven.

sides.snippet: \"Be careful that you don't do your charitable giving before men, to be seen by them, or else you have no reward from your Father who is in heaven.
sides.verseText: \"Be careful that you don't do your charitable giving before men, to be seen by them, or else you have no reward from your Father who is in heaven.
